description: Shared RoE target-normalization vectors, consumed by both the Python builder tests (decepticon_core.types.roe) and the Go launcher tests (clients/launcher/internal/engagement). A case's expected lists are what the mechanical generator must produce after normalization: embedded-list split, URL and scheme-relative collapse to hostname, CIDR canonicalization, userinfo/bracket/port stripping, lowercase and trailing-dot removal, explicit-only wildcard apex authorization, dead-pattern dropping (silently dropped entries are listed in 'dropped'; an input with no surviving target is an error in both implementations). IDNA handling is intentionally excluded: Python IDNA-encodes non-ASCII hosts, Go rejects them with an actionable message.

cases.name: url and scheme-relative reduce to host
userinfo git remote reduces to host
host with port keeps the host
wildcard does not implicitly add its apex
wildcard apex dedupes with explicit target
